note: Both sets capture the same core engineering facts correctly: window azimuth 0 for the southern louver, 50-degree solar altitude at fall equinox 12pm, the depth-to-height algorithm, the truncated isosceles triangle louver shape, the 25-degree structural bend, and the 1:1 depth-to-height ratio. Set B, however, repeats the louver shape claim twice (once with and once without the 'extruded' condition), adding a duplicate that Set A avoids. Both sets also carry a redundant/vague 'solar altitude | value | 50 degrees' claim duplicating the Harvest Shade Screen solar altitude claim. Set A is therefore slightly cleaner with the same correct content.
remarks: Both sets include a vague claim with attribute 'value' (solar altitude | value | 50 degrees) that duplicates the properly attributed Harvest Shade Screen solar altitude claim. Both also omit the derived relation 'Height = D*1.2' and the note that louver spacing was proportionally reduced based on the average of the profile widths; these are minor omissions shared by both. Quotes in both sets are truncated mid-word ('windo', 'longit') but still support their claims.
